context:
# Goal
Souji round 19 only, WAVE 2 — FALSIFY. Lane root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin (jj-colocated; branch master; base 3ab2c81479f5004c8bc91946eea482caec45408f). Wave 1 already ran; its reports are at .ufo/waves/round-19/w1/<Seat>.md and its delivered patches beside them. L1 has integrated a candidate implementation of C1/C2/C3 in the worktree; a wave is advisory and never a judge.

Declared claims:
C1 calibration — paragraph-aware carry (unmarked cut at a source physical-line end => LG-SEAT-UNCARRIED; ellipsis exactly there carries; complete paragraph carries; wrapped lesson bullet joins), strict branch gated --round>=18; seat-auditor exact delivery shapes + V-SIGNAL major; re-audit of r18 transcripts reduces false majors without laundering real ones.
C2 operability — r13/r14 runners and both count-claims consumers stamp only a durable 40-hex revision (refs/heads|refs/tags|refs/remotes, never refs/jj) whose tracked measured bytes equal the working tree; refusal exits 2 and writes no record.
C3 coverage — F5 first admitted knowledge entry from S082–S085, with SKILL rule and README row; list-only, no reap authority; base admitted count 6 (the preregistered 5 was corrected), target 7.

# What every item must do
Name the exact artifact you attack (report path, file path, or claim line). Re-derive its numbers yourself from committed bytes or the integrated files; never trust the wave-1 report. A confirmation is only useful with the command/stimulus that could have failed. If you find a defect, give the smallest failing input and the exact expected/observed divergence. Do not fix anything: L1 integrates.

# Contract (binding)
- ONE leaf seat. Never spawn subagents, never run your own swarm, never message agent://all, never call `ask`.
- Write ONLY your own report at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-19/w2/<YourName>.md (the `Report:` trailer is lane-relative). No other lane write; no patches in wave 2 unless your item explicitly asks (none do).
- No git/jj mutations; read-only git only. No signals, no /proc/*/environ, no secret content, no live census (do not run tools/souji-census.sh, tools/souji-proc-census.sh or fleet-reading fixtures unless your item names an isolated /var/tmp run). No network except the exact public doc URL your item names.
- Scratch only under /var/tmp/souji-r19w2-<YourName>/; clean it up.
- PACMAN IS PAUSED: no pacman transaction. Prefer installing nothing; record any install (tool/version/channel/reason).
- Evidence standard: unrun is unrun; quote <=25 words with URL + access date 2026-10-21 + anchor; cite lane-relative paths with lines. Report line 1 is `STATUS: DONE — …` or `STATUS: PARTIAL — …`, then `# Attack`, `# Findings`, `# Evidence`, `# Commands run`, `# Contract compliance`.
- Do not open census/operator-sweep-20261019/ or .ufo/state/.
- A line `ALLOWED-EXEC:` in your item marks an executing seat: you may run only the commands that item names, against private copies or isolated fixtures, never a live census.
